AN AGELESS REMINDER IN TIMES OF CRISIS

Before the EDSA People Power Revolution, former Manila Archbishop Jaime Cardinal Sin was instrumental in asking the public to fan the embers of the historic protest. 

The prelate called people to pray and to support the then-Vice Chief of Staff Gen. Fidel Ramos and then-Defense Minister Juan Ponce Enrile. 

Afterwards, people began flooding the streets to call for former president Ferdinand Marcos Sr.'s ouster.
